app.title: ORIENTAK: VYŠŠÍ BROD
app.subtitle: Orienteering World Cup 2026
results.title: Results
error.noWebgl: Your browser does not support WebGL2. Try a current Chrome, Safari or Firefox.
race.prestartHint: Open the map with M or the MAP button. You keep running while you read — just slower.
race.quitBody: The run in progress is thrown away — time, punches and splits. There is no way back into it.
hint.freeRun: WASD move · mouse look (click to capture) · Q/E turn · R/F pitch · Shift sprint · V camera
hint.freeRunSprint: WASD move · mouse look (click to capture) · Q/E turn · R/F pitch · Shift sprint · N noclip
nutrition.advice.sprint: A sprint under 25 minutes: orienteers carry nothing. Taking nothing during the race is the normal, correct choice.
nutrition.advice.middle: A middle around 35 minutes: nobody eats or drinks on the course. The decision is made before the start.
nutrition.advice.long: A long around 90 minutes: one carbohydrate dose around halfway is the usual pattern.
nutrition.beltHint: Taking something off the belt costs about {s} s of running. What you pack, you carry.
nutrition.verdict.onProtocol: The plan matches this race format.
nutrition.verdict.overBand: More carbohydrate than this format calls for.
nutrition.verdict.heavy: That is a very full stomach on the start line. You will feel it out there.
nutrition.summary: Before the start {carbs} g carbohydrate · on the belt {items}
nutrition.dataNote: Composition per serving, from the pack. Simplified for the game; not nutrition advice.
race.freedFromTrap: You were shut into an enclosed space — the game has moved you to the nearest passable ground.
hud.energyCause: Energy falls with pace, climb and heat. Nothing else lowers it.
settings.beginnerAidHelp: A pale blue band on the ground shows the bearing to the next control. It fades out near the control — the search is yours.
race.aidHint: The pale blue band on the ground shows the bearing to the next control — from where you think you are. It fades out near the control. Turn it off in the menu.
race.coachBearing: Bearing: line the map up with the needle and hold the direction. You are aiming at a band, not at a point.
race.coachHandrail: Handrail: follow a track, a fence or a stream even if it is longer. It is faster, and you cannot get lost on it.
race.coachAttack: Attack point: pick something unmissable within 100 m of the control, and only navigate precisely from there.
race.coachDescription: Control descriptions: read what the control is sitting on before you run into the circle.
